name: miaoda-game-inventory-core
description: Engine-agnostic inventory / item toolkit: an item catalog (stack limits, kinds, equip slots, stat-modifier payloads), slot-based containers with auto-stacking + overflow + drag-swap, named equipment slots that surface active modifiers for a stat system, and container-to-container transfer plus an atomic currency trade (the storage-box deposit/withdraw and shop workhorse). Serializable, seed-free, no rendering, no engine dependency. Backs survival backpacks, ARPG loot inventories, roguelike item bags, shops and stashes.
